contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate of an uncertain radiate ruler, AD260-275: Victorinus or Tetricus I. Mint is Gaul mint I, (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads (PAX?) [AVG]. Reverse possibly shows Pax standing left, details unclear. Obverse shows radiate bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: [...]//-. Condition is fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.15g, diameter…
